name: IT Team Performance
description: Metabase dashboard for IT Team Performance

native.query: SELECT assigned_to, COUNT(*) as open_tickets FROM hd_tickets WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND status = 'OPEN' AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY assigned_to ORDER BY open_tickets DESC

SELECT assigned_to, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (closed_at - created_at))/3600), 1) as avg_hours, COUNT(*) as total FROM hd_tickets WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assigned_to ORDER BY avg_hours
